notes: The field test is a non-randomized comparison of troops assigned to each product, using routine administration reports, so it is coded as a retrospective cohort. All analyses are bivariate with no covariates, so the results are unadjusted only. [review] Allocation is by troop (3 eastern troops vs 8 others), so formulation is confounded with region and clustered by troop; neither is addressed. The structural reader's view_issues on RR and percentage mismatches check out (38/101 vs 49/253 gives RR 1.94).
view_issues: Reported RRs do not match the table counts: withdrawal 38/101 vs 49/253 gives 1.94, not 2.51 (CI 1.51–4.18), and survival 248/253 is 98.0%, not 99.2%. The article is marked 'Corrected after publication' but the correction is not described.
